subject: CS Handoff: Access control sequencing & SSO/SCIM sprint
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-20T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: CS Handoff: Access control sequencing & SSO/SCIM sprint

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. This thread will be our working place to coordinate the access-control part of the onboarding (SSO / SCIM / IP allowlists / service accounts / org policies). Attached I’ve dropped a lightweight checklist and the runbook stub so we can capture decisions.

High-level ask: can you confirm the SAML IdP metadata and the list of public IPs we need to allow before the cutover? Also let us know which internal groups should be auto-provisioned via SCIM (e.g., Engineers, Support, Admins) and whether your security team requires dedicated service accounts for system-to-system calls.

Proposed sequencing (draft):
- Week 0: Exchange SAML metadata, agree on assertion attributes, share certs.
- Week 1: SCIM scope & attribute mapping, enable on a staging subset.
- Week 2: IP allowlist validation, service account creation + KMS/HSM binding.
- Week 3: Cutover & smoke tests, rollback plan ready.

Please attach the SAML metadata and any security questionnaire snippets you expect us to answer. I’ve cc’d Marissa (CS lead) and Jordan (implementation eng) to own schedule and technical validation.

Attachments: redwood-access-checklist.xlsx, sso-scim-runbook-v1.pdf

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

From: Elena Morales <elena@finbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinBridge IT <it@finbridge.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T11:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CS Handoff: Access control sequencing & SSO/SCIM sprint

Thanks Stephanie — appreciated the clear plan. Quick answers below and I attached our SAML metadata.

- SAML: attaching finbridge-saml-metadata.xml (IdP metadata, cert included). Our SAML uses eduPersonPrincipalName for the primary identifier; we can map to email if needed.
- SCIM: we'd like to auto-provision "Engineers" and "Support" into matching groups. Admins should be manually controlled.
- Service accounts: security wants dedicated machine accounts for any automated syncs; these must be rotated monthly and kept in HashiVault.
- IP allowlist: I’m pulling the public egress ranges from infra and will share them by EOD Friday.

One note: our procurement requires an implementation worksheet before we schedule production cutover — happy to sign once we validate the schedule.

Attachment: finbridge-saml-metadata.xml

Elena Morales
Head of IT Integrations, FinBridge
elena@finbridge.com | +1 617-555-0202

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@finbridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-22T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CS Handoff: Access control sequencing & SSO/SCIM sprint

Elena — great, thanks for the metadata. I pulled the checklist into a simple two-week schedule and left ownership notes. Proposed concrete dates:

- Nov 29 (Mon) — SAML exchange & cert validation (Jordan lead, FinBridge IT to provide test endpoint).
- Dec 1 (Wed) — SCIM attribute mapping working session (Neha lead, we’ll test with a 10-user pilot).
- Dec 6 (Mon) — IP allowlist validation (FinBridge to confirm ranges; Marissa will coordinate procurement kickoff).
- Dec 8 (Wed) — Service account provisioning and KMS integration (Jordan + FinBridge sec).
- Dec 10 (Fri) — Cutover rehearsal for subset + rollback signoff.

Action items I’ve added to the shared sheet: SAML cert expiry, SCIM attributes CSV, PO/PROC reference, and Security contacts. I linked the schedule in the thread (see related_links).

Note on procurement: If you can confirm the PO reference this week we can lock the reserved engineering hours.

Attachments: ip-allowlist-template.csv

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@finbridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-25T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CS Handoff: Access control sequencing & SSO/SCIM sprint

On Nov 22, 2027, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Elena — great, thanks for the metadata. I pulled the checklist into a simple two-week schedule and left ownership notes.

Quick technical notes from engineering:
- SAML mapping: we recommend mapping eduPersonPrincipalName -> sub and email -> email claim. We’ll provide an assertion troubleshooting guide.
- SCIM: Redwood’s SCIM connector supports group sync but does not auto-remove membership from external systems by default; confirm desired behavior for Support group.
- Service accounts naming: please use the convention finbridge-redwood-sync-{env} and provide owner emails for each account. We will create the vault entries and provide KMS-wrapped keys.
- IP allowlist: If you can provide the CIDR list as a CSV we’ll stage the allowlist in the test cluster and validate connectivity.

I’ll prepare the assertion test harness and a short runbook for SAML failures.

—Jordan
Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: CS Handoff: Access control sequencing & SSO/SCIM sprint

Elena / team — thanks all. Confirming next steps and owners so we have a single source of truth before the kickoff:

Action items:
- FinBridge: share public IP CIDR CSV and procurement PO ref (owner: Elena) — due Nov 26 (received 11/25, thanks).
- Jordan: SAML assertion harness and test endpoints (due Nov 29).
- Neha: SCIM attribute mapping doc and 10-user pilot plan (due Dec 1).
- Marissa: lock reserved engineer hours and run procurement checklist (due Nov 28).
- Stephanie: schedule kickoff 11/29 10:00 PT and send calendar invite (scheduled).

I’ve attached the finalized checklist and runbook for this track — please confirm acceptance on the sheet and flag any blocking security controls. If we’re aligned I’ll mark this lane as "ready for implementation" in the onboarding tracker.

Attachments: redwood-access-checklist.xlsx, sso-scim-runbook-v1.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
